info.name: CauseConnect — Stage 3 API handoff
info.description: Importable contract checks, not a backend implementation. Existing routes and proposed Stage 3 targets are labelled separately. Remote hosts and redirects are blocked; writes need a disposable local database acknowledgement and exact one-request arming. Read README.md before running. No requests have been executed as proof by this collection.

exec: // Requires Postman Desktop with pm.execution.skipRequest support. Never follows redirects.
if (!match || Number(match[2]) > 65535) stop('Set baseUrl to an explicit localhost HTTP port; remote hosts are blocked.');
if (!url.startsWith(base + '/') || /[\r\n]/.test(url)) stop('Request must stay on the selected local API.');
stop('Writes are disabled. Verify the backend uses a disposable database, then enable the local write guard.');
stop('Arm only this exact request name in armedWriteRequest. Whole-collection mutation runs are blocked.');
pm.environment.unset('armedWriteRequest'); // consumed even when the later request fails
if (unresolved.test(url)) stop('Set the fixture IDs needed by this request.');
if (/Id$/.test(part)) stop('An unresolved fixture ID remains.');
if (!/^Bearer [^\s]+$/.test(resolved) || unresolved.test(resolved)) stop('Run the matching fixture login or set its private local token value.');
if (unresolved.test(body)) stop('Set the fixture values needed by this JSON request.');
try { JSON.parse(body); } catch { stop('Resolved request body is not valid JSON. Check blank numeric IDs and versions.'); }
stop('Select one local disposable JPEG/PNG/WebP file before uploading.');
function check(name, fn) { pm.test(name, () => { try { fn(); } catch (error) { valid = false; throw error; } }); }
function noPrivate(v) { for (const key of ['password', 'passwordHash', 'password_hash', 'token', 'sessions', 'UserSessions', 'storage_key']) pm.expect(v).not.to.have.property(key); }
function review(v) { object(v); id(v.id); id(v.campaignId); id(v.adminId); oneOf(v.action, ['approved','rejected']); nullableText(v.comments); stamp(v.reviewedAt); }
nullableText(v.targetAudience); for (const key of ['startDate','endDate']) if(v[key] !== null) { str(v[key]); pm.expect(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v[key])).to.equal(true); }

if (v.business !== undefined && v.business !== null) { object(v.business); id(v.business.id); pm.expect(v.business.id).to.equal(v.businessId); str(v.business.businessName); nullableText(v.business.website); }
function profile(v) { object(v); id(v.id); str(v.businessName); pm.expect(v.businessName.trim().length).to.be.above(0); ['abn','website','description'].forEach(k => nullableText(v[k])); }

function user(v) { object(v); pm.expect(Object.keys(v).sort()).to.deep.equal(['id','name','email','role','status','createdAt'].sort()); id(v.id); str(v.name); str(v.email); oneOf(v.role,['public','business_owner','admin']); oneOf(v.status,['active','suspended']); stamp(v.createdAt); }

function participation(v, history = false) { object(v); pm.expect(Object.keys(v).sort()).to.deep.equal(['id','campaignId','status','participatedAt',...(history ? ['campaign'] : [])].sort()); id(v.id); id(v.campaignId); oneOf(v.status,['joined','withdrawn']); stamp(v.participatedAt); }
function enquiry(v) { object(v); ['id','campaignId','businessId'].forEach(k=>id(v[k])); ['name','email','message'].forEach(k=>str(v[k])); nullableText(v.phone); stamp(v.createdAt); noPrivate(v); }

function summary(v, campaignId) { if (v === null) return; object(v); id(v.id); pm.expect(v.id).to.equal(campaignId); str(v.title); oneOf(v.status,['pending','approved','rejected']); noPrivate(v); pm.expect(v).not.to.have.property('review'); }
function page(body, key, validate, totalRequired = true) {
const ids = new Set(); body[key].forEach(v => { validate(v); pm.expect(ids.has(v.id)).to.equal(false); ids.add(v.id); });
check('JSON response, never an SPA document', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.match(/application\/json/i); body = pm.response.json(); object(body); });
check('Contract envelope, field types and requested state', () => {
case 'profile': if(body.business !== null) profile(body.business); if(spec.saved) { profile(body.business); pm.expect(body.business.businessName).to.equal(resolvedBody.businessName.trim()); } break;

case 'participations': page(body,'participations',p=>{ participation(p,true); summary(p.campaign,p.campaignId); if(p.campaign !== null) { pm.expect(p.campaign.status).to.equal('approved'); pm.expect(p.campaign.type).to.equal('cause'); } }); break;
default: throw new Error('No contract assertion defined for ' + spec.kind);
// Run-local only: no token/password is written to the shared environment or collection.
